t: What Does The Name Bernito Mean?
s: Bernito is a diminutive or affectionate variant of the Romance name Bernardo/Bernard, ultimately from the Germanic elements bern (bear) and hard (brave, hardy), giving the sense “brave as a bear” or “strong bear.” While the most widespread forms are Bernard (English, French), Bernardo (Spanish, Portuguese, Italian), and Bernhard (German, Scandinavian), Bernito appears to follow the Iberian and Italic pattern of forming pet names with the -ito/-itto suffix (as in Spanish/Italian), much like Juanito from Juan.
